projects.title: Payroll Management System
projects.problem: [CONFIRM] Payroll done by hand is slow to calculate, and records and payslips end up scattered.
projects.solves: Employee records, salary runs and payslip generation in one workflow, with access limited by role.
projects.stackBrief: React, Node, Express and MongoDB keep it one language end to end. JWT and role-based access mean admins and staff only see what they should. PDF generation produces the payslips.

projects.title: Leave Management System
projects.problem: [CONFIRM] Leave requests and balances tracked informally, so approvals are slow and history is unclear.
projects.solves: [CONFIRM] Requests, approvals and balances in one place for staff and managers.
projects.stackBrief: [STACK] and [WHY]. Role-based access so requesters and approvers see different views.
